'TableSelectAll.js' and 'TableSelectRow.js' concern the UI and logic for (de)selecting all or individual rows. 'Table.js' is likely responsible for rendering the table structure and passing selection/filtered state to children. 'tools/filter.js' is probably involved in the row filtering logic, which determines which rows are currently visible and thus should interact with selection state. The bug involves a mismatch between which items are visible (filtered) and which are selected, so these files are all likely to be directly relevant for investigating and fixing the issue.
1.bug_scenario: The bug occurs when performing a search in the DataTable. After filtering items with the search toolbar, clicking the 'Select All' checkbox in the table header selects all items (visible and invisible) rather than only the filtered (visible) items. The expected behavior is that only the currently visible (filtered) items should be selected, but instead, all items in the dataset are affected.
